history.content: Hi, my phone can't get any signal at all. I can't make calls or use the internet. Can you help?

I can help you troubleshoot your signal issue. First, I need to identify your account to check for any line or account-related problems. Could you please provide one of the following:

- Your phone number
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll begin the troubleshooting process.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you for providing your information. Your line status is currently active, so let's begin troubleshooting your signal issue.

To start, could you please check your phone's status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon (✈️)
- "No Signal" or a signal strength indicator (bars)
- Any other unusual icons

This will help determine if the issue is related to your device settings or something else. If you need guidance on how to check, let me know your phone model and I can assist further.
My status bar says 'No Signal' and 'Data Disabled', but it also shows 'Connected to Chestnut-5G'. There are no signal bars and no airplane mode icon.

Your device is a Pixel 8 Pro and is active. To continue troubleshooting, please check your SIM card status on your phone. Here’s how:

1. Go to your phone’s Settings.
2. Tap on “Network & Internet” or “Connections.”
3. Select “SIM cards” or “SIM status.”
4. Let me know if it says the SIM is active, missing, or locked.

This will help determine if the issue is with your SIM card. If you need step-by-step guidance, let me know!
It says the SIM is locked.

Thank you for checking. Since your SIM card is locked, you will not be able to connect to the cellular network or get any signal. Unlocking a SIM that is locked due to incorrect PIN or PUK entries requires specialized support.

I am unable to unlock SIM cards directly. I will transfer you to a human agent who can assist you further with unlocking your SIM.

YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.
